rows.en: You two really get along great!
(Let's see, who's teaching the next class...)
It's Pinon's lecture.
rows.notes: Kagura (Yuuto), male-player version; bare 'Pinon' as in the Japanese.

rows.en: Oh right, thanks, Yuuto.
Oh, Pinon-chan just came in...
Class is starting!
Wh-huh...?
Pinon-chan disappeared?

The teacher's desk in this classroom is so tall
that someone Pinon's height gets hidden
behind it, it seems.
Isn't there a step or a platform or something?

Knowing her, I bet she wouldn't use one
even if there was...
True...
Qui-et-down-al-rea-dy!
rows.notes: Drawn-out syllable by syllable in the Japanese.

rows.en:
Y-you lot, if you don't quiet down,
I'll flunk every last one of you!
Pinon-chan, you're so scaaary!

It's Pinon-SEN-SEI!
Don't you call me Pinon-chan!
Ooookay! Pinon-seeensei!
Th-that's fine, as long as you understand.

Looks like she's not budging from behind that
desk no matter what. She could just step
to the side...

Well, Pinon's classes are easy to follow.
Isn't it fine the way it is?
I guess so...

\p,
you've got some nerve, chatting in my class.
Uh, no, um...
(...When did she get over here...?)
...You look like you have something to say?
Ah, ahaha...

As punishment, you will read
from page 71 to page 120!
N-no way! That's 50 pages!?
It's punishment! Of course it is!
(Somebody help me~)
It's Pinon-sensei's lecture.
Oh right, thanks, Miyuki.

The teacher's desk in this classroom is so tall
that someone Pinon-sensei's height
gets hidden behind it, it seems...

Knowing that girl, I don't think
she'd use one even if there was...

Looks like she's not budging from behind that
desk no matter what. She could just step
to the side...
rows.notes: Female only (Japanese differs from c02770 only by sentence-final particle).

rows.en:
She may be like that, but her classes are easy
to follow. Isn't it fine the way it is?
You think so?
(...When did she get over here...?)

(Huh?
Who's that over there...?)
Heeey, Pinon-chaaan!
What's the matter? What are you doing here?

That's my line.
What are YOU doing here, Pinon-chan?
W-well...
It's like this...
...Like what?
I-it's a secret!!
Awww~~~

I am busy!
If you've got no business here, go away! Shoo! Shoo!
You don't look busy to me...
I-I'm about to get busy...!
Hmmm...
Oh, reeeally?
It is true!... Wait, who are you?!

That's cold, Pino-Pino~
'Tis I, the great Yui Hoshimura!
rows.notes: 'Pinopino': Yui's nickname for Pinon, glossary alias 'Pino-Pino'. Old-fashioned diction per glossary.

rows.en: ...When did you get here?
Pino-Pino's up to something fun... ahem!
rows.notes: Yui's slip ('something fun with Pino-Pino'), corrected in the next row.

rows.en:
Whenever Pino-Pino is troubled,
the great Yui comes dashing to the rescue!
You just took that back, didn't you?
She took it back.

Never mind the small stuff, I say!
Now then, Pino-Pino...

Confess the great worries you've
stored up in that little chest of yours!
rows.notes: 'Chiisana mune': keeps the dig at Pinon's small chest.

rows.en: Maybe I'll head home too.

Wha-! W-wait a sec, Pino-Pino! Let's calm down
and take a deep breath!
Hee-hee-hoo! Hee-hee-hoo!!
You're the one who needs to calm down most.
What is this?! Why are you getting in my way?!

I'm not getting in your way!
As your friend, I wanna share your worries,
Pino-Pino!

I-I don't have any worries!
I just came to buy some clothes!
Huh, clothes...

Well, well, then let's go look!
What kind of clothes do you want?

I want an outfit like Hilda's,
one befitting an educator!

See?!
You think it won't suit me!

Wh-who says it isn't not maybe
not unlikely to... possibly...?
rows.notes: Deliberately tangled stack of negatives in the Japanese.

rows.en: Your eyes are darting all over!
W-well, let's at least go take a look!
Grrrrrr~!

So that's that, see ya~
Come on, let's go, Pino-Pino!!
Stop dragging me~!
(Hang in there, Pinon-chan...!)

That's my line.
What are YOU doing here, Pinon-chan?
Maybe I'll head home too.

uncertain: c02813/c02831: 'boku/watashi mo kaerou ka na' rendered 'Maybe I'll head home too.'; 'too' presumably follows Pinon's attempt to leave (no line shows it).
